quote: Gemini 2.0 Flash is now generally available, with higher rate limits, stronger performance, and simplified pricing.
note: Lab (Google DeepMind) and kind (shipped model) confirmed. The first public availability was the experimental Gemini 2.0 Flash, announced Dec 11, 2024 and available 'to all developers' via the Gemini API, AI Studio and Vertex AI (quote: "Gemini 2.0 Flash is available now as an experimental model to developers via the Gemini API in Google AI Studio" and "with multimodal input and text output available to all developers"; https://blog.google/technology/google-deepmind/google-gemini-ai-update-december-2024/). Per the convention that a preview precedes general release, the GA date is recorded in release and the experimental date in preview_date. The Feb 5, 2025 Google post (https://blog.google/technology/google-deepmind/gemini-model-updates-february-2025/) says an updated 2.0 Flash reached all Gemini app users the week before; I did not open a primary source for that app rollout date, and secondary reports put it around Jan 30, 2025. Not settled: whether 'public' should mean the open Dec 11, 2024 experimental release instead. I followed the preview/GA rule, so Feb 5, 2025 is 'release' and Dec 11, 2024 is 'preview_date'.
